name: Margaret Higgins
psychographics: Values self-sufficiency and community stability above all else
current_solutions: Uses the local co-op for groceries and buys clothes from the thrift store on Main Street
frustration: Tried to order medicine from the pharmacy app at 2 PM on Tuesday; the app froze on the payment screen and she had to drive 20 miles to the brick-and-mortar shop because the local line was already closed
decision_style: Sticks with brands she has used for decades; rarely tries new products unless a neighbor recommends them
voice: Soft-spoken but firm, moves slowly through sentences, often stops to clarify a word, rarely uses slang
